   def self.consume_long(accs : Pointer(UInt32), ptr : Pointer(UInt8), len : Int32) : Pointer(UInt8)
     input = ptr
     limit = ptr + (len - 15)
+    # Unroll 4 iterations (64 bytes) to increase ILP
+    while input + 64 <= limit
+      # iter 1

+      # iter 2

+      accs[1] = round(accs[1], XXH::Primitives.read_u32_le(input)); input += 4
+      accs[2] = round(accs[2], XXH::Primitives.read_u32_le(input)); input += 4
+      accs[3] = round(accs[3], XXH::Primitives.read_u32_le(input)); input += 4
+      # iter 3

+      accs[2] = round(accs[2], XXH::Primitives.read_u32_le(input)); input += 4
+      accs[3] = round(accs[3], XXH::Primitives.read_u32_le(input)); input += 4
+      # iter 4

+    end

     # Consume chunks of 32 bytes (4 lanes × 8 bytes)
     input = ptr
     limit = ptr + (len - 31)
+    # Unrolled loop (2×32 bytes per iteration) with light prefetch
+    prefetch_dist = 64
+    while input + prefetch_dist < limit
+      # prefetch next cache line (software read)
+      _ = XXH::Primitives.read_u64_le(input + prefetch_dist)

+      # first 32 bytes
+      accs[0] = round(accs[0], XXH::Primitives.read_u64_le(input))
+      input += 8

+      accs[3] = round(accs[3], XXH::Primitives.read_u64_le(input))
+      input += 8
+
